caption: The drawing depicts a full-length, off-the-shoulder dress displayed on a mannequin with no head or arms. The dress is primarily white with layers of sheer, flowing fabric. It features diagonal and horizontal bands of violet or lavender trim, decorated with ruffles and lace edging. Two large pink roses with green leaves are positioned as decorative elements, one at the center of the neckline and another on the left side of the skirt near the hip. There is additional detailing in the ruffled layers, giving the dress a voluminous and ornate appearance. In the top right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, sketched outline of the dress showing a simplified version of the overall design and construction. The background is plain and cream-colored, and the lines of the drawing are done in pencil, with portions of the dress colored in with subtle shades of purple, pink, and green.
title: Dress
